'''Herr Gruber's Spa''' is a spa advertised on the in-game radio in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==Description==
The spa is run by Herr Gruber and appears to use physical and verbal abuse to achieve results.

It is located somewhere in the [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|state of San Andreas]]; however, it is only mentioned and cannot be found in-game.

==Influence==
The name "Herr Gruber" may be a reference to the character {{WP|Hans Gruber}} from the [[1988]] movie ''{{WP|Die Hard}}''.
